title: Math model specification
description: Versioned target specification of the game's mathematics: RTP target and tolerance, volatility, hit frequency, per-source RTP contributions, tier trigger probabilities, retrigger/cascade bounds, max-win cap and termination, bonus-buy and enhanced-chance models, and the simulation policy. The simulator verifies measured values against this document; base + feature + super_feature + ultimate_feature + scatterPay (+ jackpot) contributions must sum to targetRtp within ±0.0005 (checked by the simulator, not expressible in JSON Schema).

mathVersion.description: Semver of this math model; must match mathVersion in game-config.json.

targetRtp.description: Total target RTP fraction of the default profile (e.g. 0.9600).

rtpTolerance.description: Maximum allowed absolute |simRTP - targetRtp| at release-level simulation size. Must also fall within the 99% CI half-width (CONVENTIONS §5); hard cap 0.003.

volatilityClass.description: Target volatility class of the default profile.

targetHitFrequency.description: Target fraction of rounds with any win (win > 0), e.g. 0.28.

contributions.description: Planned RTP contribution of each win source, as fractions of total bet. Contributions must sum to targetRtp ±0.0005 (simulator gate).

scatterPay.description: Direct scatter pays outside feature wins.

jackpot.description: Fixed jackpot awards (JP_MINI..JP_GRAND). Omit when the game has no jackpots.

featureTriggerProb.description: Natural per-round trigger probability of each tier (base game, no enhanced chance).

feature.description: P(exactly the `feature` tier triggers) per round, e.g. 0.005 = 1 in 200.

super_feature.description: P(exactly the `super_feature` tier triggers) per round.

retriggerRules.description: Feature retrigger policy. Caps are mandatory: no unbounded feature length.

allowed.description: Whether features can retrigger at all.

capPerFeature.description: Hard maximum number of retriggers within one feature instance. Must be 0 when allowed is false.

enabled.description: Whether winning symbols cascade (are removed and refilled).

capPerSpin.description: Hard maximum cascade steps within one spin (termination guarantee). Required when enabled is true.

multiplierProgression.description: Optional whole-number win multiplier applied at cascade step 1, 2, 3, …; the last value persists for further steps up to capPerSpin.

maxWin.description: Max-win cap and how a round ends when it is reached (max_win_termination step in the outcome manifest).

xBet.description: Cap as a whole-number multiple of total bet; must equal maxWinXBet in game-config.json.

terminationPolicy.description: end_round_pay_cap: round stops immediately, cap paid. end_feature_pay_cap: current feature ends, cap paid. continue_no_extra_pay: presentation continues but no win above cap is added.

bonusBuy.description: Bonus-buy models — one per purchasable mode. Omit (or empty) when bonus buy is not built. Each mode gets separate simulation results.

modeId.description: Unique id of the buy mode, e.g. "buy-feature", "buy-ultimate".

priceXBet100.description: Purchase price as integer hundredths of a bet (100x bet -> 10000).

entryTier.description: Tier the purchase guarantees entry into.

rtp.description: Target RTP of the buy mode relative to its price.

enhancedChance.description: Enhanced-chance (ante bet) model. Required fields expand when enabled is true.

anteMultiplier100.description: Total-bet cost multiplier in x100 fixed-point (1.25x bet -> 125). Required when enabled.

effect.description: Precise math effect, e.g. "feature trigger probability doubled via reel set base-ante". Required when enabled.

rtp.description: Target RTP of the enhanced-chance mode relative to the raised bet.

simulationPolicy.description: Simulation sizing and rare-event policy. Every run records the full reproducibility block (CONVENTIONS §5).

devRounds.description: Rounds per development-iteration simulation. Minimum 1e6 rounds.

releaseRounds.description: Rounds for the release-gate simulation (RTP tolerance is judged at this size).

ciTarget.description: Confidence level used for RTP interval reporting (e.g. 0.99).

rareEventStrategy.description: Variance-reduction strategy for rare events (ultimate tier, max win): plain Monte Carlo, stratified sampling, or importance sampling.

allOf.$comment: Validation message: 'cascadeRules.capPerSpin is required when cascadeRules.enabled is true.'
Validation message: 'retriggerRules.capPerFeature must be 0 when retriggerRules.allowed is false.'
Validation message: 'enhancedChance.anteMultiplier100 and enhancedChance.effect are required when enhancedChance.enabled is true.'

rtpFraction.description: One win source's RTP contribution as a fraction of total bet.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
